label: PERFECTION_OF_BEING_1: thin reading, only being itself is a perfection of being
term: thin reading of perfection of being
definition: `ThinOfBeing being d`: d is a perfection of being only if d is the determination `being` itself. On this reading, 'whatever is its own being lacks no perfection of being' says only that it has being. Distinguishing conditions: it is the reading of a view on which existence adds no content to an essence; it does not count life or wisdom as perfections of being (contrast PERFECTION_OF_BEING_2).
note: Stipulative analyst definition of a rival reading, attributed to no source; introduced for docs/notes/mode-of-being-subsistent-esse.md.
